cmd: cat /var/log/vps-durations.log; echo; echo '--- stats main ---'; grep ' main duration' /var/log/vps-durations.log | grep -oE '[0-9]+s$' | tr -d 's' | awk '{s+=$1; n++; if($1>max)max=$1; if(min==""||$1<min)min=$1} END{if(n>0) print "n="n" avg="s/n"s min="min"s max="max"s"; else print "нет данных"}'; echo '--- stats satellite ---'; grep ' satellite duration' /var/log/vps-durations.log | grep -oE '[0-9]+s$' | tr -d 's' | awk '{s+=$1; n++; if($1>max)max=$1; if(min==""||$1<min)min=$1} END{if(n>0) print "n="n" avg="s/n"s min="min"s max="max"s"; else print "нет данных"}'
